acceptance_criteria.description: Tool trajectory matches expected ground-truth calls.
Final response achieves semantic/lexical similarity threshold.

business_objective: Design a Google ADK 2.12 graph_workflow, not a live voice agent. Use a Workflow with FunctionNode and JoinNode. No audio, video, BigQuery, or code execution tools are required. Build ASTERGRID: a local FastAPI backend and React TypeScript Three.js frontend. The workflow validates a synthetic scenario, builds a seeded world, runs conditions, resource allocation, and accessibility analysis concurrently, joins outputs, performs preflight verification, runs a deterministic simulation, performs outcome verification, applies at most two bounded revisions, and produces a reproducible report. Roles: Scenario Director, Intake, World Builder, Conditions, Resources, Accessibility, Simulation, Critic, Reporter. Deterministic policy mode must work without any model API key; optional Gemini mode is key-gated. Persist with SQLite, stream ordered events over SSE, validate all artifacts with Pydantic. Fictional emergency coordination only; no military targeting or real-world operational use.
